title: Observation-first inverse lane input contract
question: Can observation-constrained inverse inference be registered beside the forward proof lane without treating Pre-A as true, reusing fitted anchors as predictions, inferring dynamics from static data, or promoting finite TECT and TECT-YM suppliers to physical QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity results; and does any current microscopic candidate already have a complete admitted forward map?
method: Reuse the R-168 evidence-role, candidate-neutral estimand, candidate-specific map, prospective-freeze, and anti-leakage authorities by pointer rather than copying their matrices.
Separate mathematical theorem, model consistency, physical identity, and empirical validation, then decompose each candidate forward law into F_reg, F_lim, F_eff, and F_obs.
Separate physical dynamics ownership from proof-realization ownership and require prediction invariance across admitted proof realizations.
Register five calibration packets, six public retrospective targets, and one intentionally empty prospective lock with raw-source lineage and no-retuning rules.

Audit M0, M1, M2, M5, the finite F_ref Langevin comparison, the T-055 geometry candidate, and the reference-only TECT-YM supplier against existence, quotient identifiability, stability, and prospective predictivity.
Run the machine contract validator and four hostile mutations; retain noncompensatory hard gates, equivalence-class reporting, and the physical-empty/uniform-limit firewalls.
finding: The parallel inverse lane is well-defined as a T0 input and adjudication contract, but no scientific candidate verdict is available. All public observation packets are calibration or retrospective for the current programme, PROS-LOCK-001 is empty, and zero microscopic candidates have a complete admitted F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map. M0 remains the mandatory effective baseline only; M1, M2, the F_ref comparison, T-055 geometry, and the external TECT-YM supplier are NOT_ADMITTED, while the frozen bare M5 version retains its scoped failure. The next progress gate is one complete owner-and-forward-map package, not another equivalent finite table.
decision_reason: The route advances at the research-contract level because it creates an independent falsifier-first path from observations to surviving microscopic equivalence classes, makes leakage and nonidentifiability fail closed, and supplies a concrete admission gate. It does not advance a candidate, theorem tier, physical identity, or empirical conclusion.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing strategy and input-contract registration only. No observation data product is locally hash-frozen, no likelihood or candidate has been run, no prospective commitment or target exists, and no microscopic map is admitted. Existing TECT and TECT-YM evidence keeps its finite, conditional, auxiliary, or reference-only scope.
next_action: Hash-freeze the exact source and data products plus candidate-neutral estimands, then construct one candidate-complete physical/proof owner and F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map. Stop scoring if no map is admitted; report a surviving equivalence class if twins remain; issue one synthesis PDF only after a real gate-level admission, survival, or falsification checkpoint.

adversarial_review.check: The contract begins from a generally set-valued predictive inverse and never assumes that observations uniquely determine Pre-A.
R-193/R-200-type mobility twins force NONIDENTIFIABLE under static-only anchors.
All already-public targets are retrospective and only the empty future lock can earn prospective credit.
Good fit cannot compensate for a missing physical owner, proof owner, map stage, or uniform bound.
TECT and TECT-YM authorities are locator-only; no counterpart matrix is copied or promoted.
Observation anchors cannot replace owner-approved E or the common Reading-H functional contract.
A3 scalar baselines and finite suppliers stay finite/conditional until common-core uniform limits and physical identity close.

non_claims: No microscopic candidate is selected, ruled unique, stable, or prospectively predictive.
No Reading-H physical-empty sign, C6, Pre-A, A13, Sector-A, physical-sector, continuum, Yang-Mills, gravity, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything, or mass-gap result is established.
The temporal sidecar changes no scientific exploration verdict; it only marks affected recorded_at values as untrusted.
